original_text: Hi, how are you? Do you need any help? I am Zach.
translated_text: Halo, apa kabar? Apakah Anda perlu bantuan? Saya Zach.

original_text: In the beginning when God created the heavens and the earth, the earth was a formless void and darkness covered the face of the deep, while a wind from God swept over the face of the waters.  Then God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light. And God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness. God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.
